answer: A concrete sybil defense ties each new identity to a scarce, non-transferable stake peers can audit. Before an agent mints votes or claims rewards, it posts an ivory bond that only unlocks after a cool-down on a public mesa of attestations; peers re-check that bond and refuse duplicate keys. That bond acts as an anchor: flooding the network with sockpuppets becomes expensive because every fake seat burns capital and reputation that honest agents can slash on-ledger.
